correctness.rationale: The seven weight-3 Hamming codewords correspond to Fano lines; their weight-4 complements pair with them. For a line with t=0,1,2 internal edges of the cyclic order, pair weights are 6-t and 7-t. Each of seven cycle edges belongs to one Fano line, so b0=b2=a and b1=7-2a; Fano intersection forces a<=2. Counting all 360 unoriented 7-cycles: first incidence 7*72=504 and pair-line incidence 21*8=168, giving N0,N1,N2=(24,168,168). GL3(F2) of order168 identifies equivalent parity-check lists, giving 30 indexed codes distributed (2,14,14) and the advertised exact weight polynomials. Independently enumerated all 360 cycles and all 5040 column permutations, directly generated all 16 codewords for each and found exactly the three enumerators with multiplicities 2,14,14.
